feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 3 June 2026 5:38am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds developing.


##Wind)##

S 4 occasionally 5, soon increasing 5 or 6, occasionally 7 for time. Veering SW late morning.


##State of sea)##

Slight, soon becoming mainly moderate, building rough for a time.


##Weather)##

Rain soon arriving, clearing to scattered showers in the afternoon and evening, becoming isolated overnight.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain and showers.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 11°C and max. air temperature 15°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
##Tomorrow##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds.


##Wind)##

W or SW 5 or 6, veering W or WNW 6 or 7 for a time late Thursday evening and early night.


##State of sea)##

Moderate, occasionally rough for a time.


##Weather)##

Showers, becoming isolated later.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor in showers.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 15°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
##Friday, 5 June 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds at first and again later.


##Wind)##

W or SW 5 or 6, soon decreasing S or SW 4 or 5. Backing S or SE later. Occasionally 6 early Saturday morning.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather)##

Showers, mainly isolated.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate in showers.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 13°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
##Saturday, 6 June 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds at first.


##Wind)##

SE 5 or 6, occasionally 7 for a time, veering W or SW 3 to 5 later.


##State of sea)##

Moderate, occasionally rough for a time. Decreasing slight or moderate later.


##Weather)##

Outbreaks of rain for much of the day, persistent at times. Becoming fair overnight into Sunday.


##Visibility)##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 14°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
##Sunday, 7 June 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds at first.


##Wind)##

SW 5 or 6, decreasing 3 or 4 later.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather)##

Fair, risk of isolated showers.


##Visibility)##

Good.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 14°C
